raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Customers migrated to the new CRM on 2026-01-15 now arrive with numeric region codes ('01'-'04') instead of region names. silver_customers passes these codes through unchanged, which splits the gold_region_daily aggregates. raw_region_map gives an unambiguous one-to-one translation from code to region name, so the codes can be mapped back to names.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.9, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(upper(m.region_name), upper(c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT region_code, region_name FROM raw_region_map) m ON trim(c.region) = m.region_code"}}
